patches.name: Bypass developer options

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app anti-tampering protection so to work when signed by a different signature.

patches.name: Fix Other discussions
patches.description: Fixes the 'Other discussions' tab showing '403 error loading page' by updating the API endpoint.

patches.name: Spoof Firebase certificate hash
patches.description: Spoofs the app's package certificate hash used by Firebase Installations so that push notifications, remote config, and other Firebase services continue to work as expected.

options.title: Certificate hash
options.description: The SHA-1 hash of the app's package certificate.

patches.name: Spoof signature verification
patches.description: Spoofs the signature verification when the app starts up. It is recommended to use the unmodified app to work properly.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The package name of the app, if modified. This must match the package name defined when the 'Change package name' patch is selected or as defined in the AndroidManifest.xml.

options.title: Base64-encoded signature
options.description: The base64-encoded signature from the original, unmodified APK. This extracts the certificate/signature in the APK by default if blank.
